strong_numerical_result: For a finite record, Z_n(s)=sum P0^s P1^(1-s) has second derivative sum w(log(P0/P1))^2>0, so strict convexity and uniqueness conditional on a derivative zero are exact. Long-double evaluation gives opposite derivative signs at the displayed endpoints and therefore strong numerical isolation of the length-16 optimizer. The quasi-multiplicative constants c=3/10 and C=12/5 are independent of s; inserting the numerical block enclosure gives the displayed conservative candidate outer bracket for the optimized asymptotic Chernoff rate.
